title: Garmin Zumo Ride Event Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).

description: Detects when Garmin Zumo ride event data has stopped arriving for a given route name.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per route name and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
detailedImplementation:
## Prerequisites

• **Splunk**: Splunk Enterprise ≥9.0 or Splunk Cloud — a single-instance home lab is fine. Create `index=personal` with 90–365 day retention (`indexes.conf`).
• **HEC token**: Settings → Data Inputs → HTTP Event Collector → New Token → index `personal`. Store the token in your connector's environment (never commit it to git).
• **Upstream product**: Garmin Connect — Garmin Health API or third-party export → HEC.
• **Subcategory context**: Motorcycles & Powersports — typical feeds: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`)..
• **Sourcetypes in this search**: `garmin:zumo`.
• **Network**: The connector host must reach both the vendor API/MQTT broker and your Splunk HEC port (8088/tcp).

## Step 1 — Configure data collection

Route **Garmin Connect** events into `index=personal` with `sourcetype=garmin:zumo`.

**Collection method:** Garmin Health API or third-party export → HEC.

**Reference endpoint / path:** `Garmin Connect IQ / Health API activity summaries`.

**Suggested poll interval:** 3600s.

**Key fields to extract:** `activityType, distance, duration, startTimeGMT`.

**Typical connector stack:** Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk..

**Author notes:** Track the latest event time per route name and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.


Example HEC payload shape:

```json
{"index": "personal", "sourcetype": "garmin:zumo", "event": { ... vendor fields ... }}
```

Verify ingestion with:

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:zumo earliest=-24h | head 20
```

## Step 2 — Create the search and alert

This search implements **Garmin Zumo Ride Event Sync Gap Watch** over `personal` data (primarily `sourcetype=garmin:zumo`) across the full search range. It applies numeric thresholds on `hours_since` (> 72) after max — tune these constants to your household baseline.

**Fields this search depends on:** `hours_since`, `route_name`. Confirm each is populated before scheduling alerts.

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:zumo
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by route_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
```

## Step 3 — Validate

**(a) Compare to vendor UI:** Garmin Connect → Activities calendar. Totals for the same day/week should match within connector lag (usually one poll interval).

**(b) Field presence:**

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:zumo earliest=-7d
| head 50
| table hours_since, route_name
```

Every column the detection uses should be non-null on recent rows.

**(c) Volume sanity:**

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:zumo earliest=-30d
| timechart span=1d count
```

Flatlines usually mean a broken token, expired OAuth refresh, or HEC URL change.

**(d) Threshold calibration:** Profile `hours_since` before alerting:

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:zumo earliest=-30d
| stats perc50(hours_since) AS p50 perc90(hours_since) AS p90 perc99(hours_since) AS p99 max(hours_since) AS hi
```

## Step 4 — Operationalize

Create a companion dashboard titled `UC-25.64.6: Personal evidence` with the following panel layout:

**Panel 1 — Table Of Entities By Hours Since Last Event (the key fields):** Configure according to standard Splunk visualization patterns for this panel type.


Time picker defaults: set to last 30 days with named presets for 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, and 1y — the auditor needs all five windows without retyping. Enable scheduled PDF export for the full dashboard on the regulation's reporting cadence.

## Step 5 — Troubleshooting

**Garmin Connect — no Garmin Connect events / missing fields:** If `garmin:zumo` stops updating, re-check HEC token, index `personal`, and firewall to port 8088. Search `index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd group=http_event_collector` for rejection reasons. Confirm the Garmin Connect connector script is still running (`systemctl status` or cron log).

**Garmin Connect — NULL values in extracted fields:** The Garmin Connect JSON export shape drifted — compare a raw event (`index=personal sourcetype=garmin:zumo | head 1 | spath`) against the field names in Step 2. Re-map in the connector before changing the SPL.

**Garmin Connect — API error / auth denied (401/403):** Refresh tokens expire on most consumer APIs — re-authorize the scripted input, update `passwords.conf` / env vars, and verify the vendor developer app is not in sandbox mode.

**Garmin Connect — endpoint timeout / HTTP 429 throttling:** Back off the poll interval in the connector; Garmin Connect APIs often cap requests per 15 minutes on free tiers.

**Stale dashboard:** Confirm the saved search `dispatch.earliest_time` covers enough history for your `aggregation` buckets.
